name: Falha no processamento de OS
query: SELECT count(*) FROM OrdemServicoEvento WHERE evento = 'falha' AND inesperada IS true AND appName = 'oficina-api-__AMBIENTE__'

name: Notificacao de OS nao publicada no SNS
query: SELECT count(*) FROM Log WHERE entity.name = 'oficina-api-__AMBIENTE__' AND message LIKE 'Falha ao publicar notificacao%'

name: Taxa de erro da API acima de 5%
query: SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE error IS true) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'oficina-api-__AMBIENTE__'

name: Latencia p95 da API acima de 1 s
query: SELECT percentile(duration, 95) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'oficina-api-__AMBIENTE__'

name: Containers da API reiniciando
query: SELECT sum(restartCountDelta) FROM K8sContainerSample WHERE clusterName = 'oficina-__AMBIENTE__-eks' AND namespaceName = 'oficina'

name: HPA no teto de replicas
query: SELECT latest(currentReplicas) FROM K8sHpaSample WHERE clusterName = 'oficina-__AMBIENTE__-eks' AND namespaceName = 'oficina'

name: Health check externo falhando
query: SELECT count(*) FROM SyntheticCheck WHERE monitorName = 'oficina-health-__AMBIENTE__' AND result != 'SUCCESS'
